query: Which document types (articles, reviews) will form the primary corpus for headline bibliometric claims versus which types (conference abstracts, preprints, theses) will be treated as sensitivity inputs?

response.query: Which document types (articles, reviews) will form the primary corpus for headline bibliometric claims versus which types (conference abstracts, preprints, theses) will be treated as sensitivity inputs?
response.answer: Primary corpus for headline bibliometric claims will be peer-reviewed articles and reviews. Conference abstracts, preprints, and theses will be treated as sensitivity inputs.
